sc: Teenage girl, malar rash, joint pains, proteinuria, low C3 → Lupus nephritis
Girl 7 yr, cannot climb stairs, violet eyelids, papules on the knuckles → Dermatomyositis
f: SLE: fever, fatigue, joint pains, photosensitivity, mouth ulcers · JDM: weakness on stairs, rash
Malar rash sparing the nasolabial folds · oedema, ↑ BP (nephritis) · JDM: heliotrope rash, Gottron papules, Gowers sign
ANA = best screen · anti-Sm most specific · anti-dsDNA + low C3/C4 = activity · urine every visit · JDM: CK, thigh MRI
Hydroxychloroquine for all · prednisolone · severe nephritis: IV methylprednisolone + MMF or cyclophosphamide · JDM: steroid + methotrexate
Lupus nephritis (main cause of death) · infection · thrombosis · JDM: calcinosis, aspiration
trap: Neonatal lupus: heart block is permanent, the rash goes · lupus + fever + high CRP → infection · JDM in children is not linked to cancer
